issue: PROPER discovery sweep for Paraguay (landlocked — checked specifically for any river/virtual-pipeline LNG hub or Río Paraguay FSRU/barge regas, per brief). Result: ZERO in-scope LNG terminals, none missing from GEM. Findings: (1) Paraguay's energy is hydropower-dominated (Itaipú, Yacyretá); no LNG import/regas terminal proposed. (2) The active gas project is the Gasoducto Bioceánico (Vaca Muerta gas: Argentina -> Paraguayan Chaco -> Brazil/Mato Grosso do Sul, ~1,050 km, ~US$2bn Paraguay segment) — a PIPELINE, out of scope for the LNG terminals tracker, and itself only at MOU/feasibility-study stage (MOUs with Brazil Feb-2025, Mato Grosso do Sul Jun-2025, Argentina Jul-2025; no detailed engineering, no construction contracts, no committed consortium). (3) 'Villeta, Paraguay' surfaces only for the Omega Green biorefinery (HVO/SAF green diesel & aviation biofuel) — NOT an LNG terminal. No FSRU, no LNG barge, no regas facility on the Paraguay/Paraná river found.
suggested_action: No new_terminal and no monitor entry for Paraguay. The Bioceánico is a pipeline (track in the gas-pipelines tracker if at all, not LNG terminals). Re-confirm at a future batch only if Paraguay proposes an actual LNG receiving/regas facility (e.g., a Río Paraguay FSRU or barge regas tied to the planned ~1,000 MW Chaco gas power plant); none exists today.
